phase: H3.2 T-H5 selection-flow adjudication (quasi-static: guarded Routhian descent at fixed L alternated with the clock update L^2 = (2/3) I E_static, from the rigid rung)

protocol.kernel: fs-gum-kern tiled deterministic layer (bit-identical at any thread count)
protocol.projection_rule: cells with r > r_c of the current (1 - q0) centroid reset to the static-anchor snapshot, then renormalize; applied after each descent block, before the clock update reads (I, E_static)

rigid_rung.unit_map: kappa_paper = 2 sqrt(pi) L / I; L_rigid = sqrt(7/6) I_static/(2 sqrt(pi))

control_halo_1p5rstar.projection_desc: far-field re-seed at 1.5 R* (the campaign halo diagnostic radius)

control_support_1p25rstar.projection_desc: compact-support re-seed at 1.25 R* (just above the corpus in-family support V^(1/3) R* ~ 1.12 R*)

analysis.kappa_convention: kappa_paper_next = 2 sqrt(pi) L_next / I (the clock-consistent state at each cycle end)
